subject: Acme renewal & expansion — call recap and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Susie Chen <susie.chen@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Acme renewal & expansion — call recap and next steps

Hi Susie — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned.

What we covered
- Current usage: ~1.2B tokens/month (Q2 average); peak storefront workloads during launches.
- Pain points: rising per-token costs on peak days, occasional 500–800ms tail latency on long-chat flows, visibility gaps into per-route cost.
- Goals: reduce per-token unit cost by ~30% while keeping 95th pct latency under 400ms; add a dedicated inference path for search reranking workloads.

Proposed expansion
- Renew hosted plan for another 12 months (start: 2026-09-01) with a Dedicated pool for reranking (reserved GPU capacity) + prefix caching for storefront flows.
- Expected impact: ~25–35% cost reduction on the targeted workloads and consistent p95 latency under 400ms.

Open questions you raised
- Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) for regulated data — we confirmed this is available but would need an addendum and ~6–8 week onboarding.
- Procurement timeline — you mentioned an early Sept renewal target and procurement involvement next week.

Next steps (ownership)
1) I’ll send a tailored quote & Q2 usage report by EOD tomorrow — ACTION: Marissa
2) You’ll share procurement contact info and preferred PO process — ACTION: Susie
3) Quick follow-up meeting (30m) to review pricing and rollout plan — propose Wed 8/25 or Thu 8/26 — ACTION: all

Attachments I’ll include: renewal quote + Q2 usage export.

If I missed anything, flag it here — otherwise I’ll plan to lock in the mutual action plan after procurement confirms timeline.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192

--

Subject: Re: Acme renewal & expansion — call recap and next steps

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful.

Couple clarifications from my side:
- Can you confirm whether the Dedicated pool supports G5x or equivalent instances? Our infra standard prefers that class for throughput.
- For the private/VPC option, do you have a standard addendum or security questionnaire we can start with? Procurement will want an estimated onboarding window and an SOW.

Procurement (cc’d) — I’ve flagged this renewal; our target is to complete commercial terms by 9/3 to avoid service interruption.

Quick note: pricing sensitivity — we’ll need to see a clear delta between hosted and dedicated pricing + committed spend tiers so we can evaluate.

Thanks — Susie
Susie Chen
Head of AI Platforms | Acme Corp
susie.chen@acmecorp.com

Subject: Re: Acme renewal & expansion — call recap and next steps

Hi Susie — good questions. Answers and attached materials below.

Dedicated pool & instance class
- Yes — we can provision Dedicated pools on G5x-class GPUs (or equivalent) for the reranking workload. We’ll size based on your qps: from our call, recommended starting config is 4x G5x with autoscale headroom for bursts.

Private/VPC + security addendum
- We have a standard Private deployment addendum and an initial security pack (SOC 2 summary, data flow diagram, matrix of controls). Onboarding for Private is typically 6–8 weeks once the contract and infra access are in place. I attached the security pack and usage CSV for Q2.

Pricing & committed tiers (high level)
- Renewal (hosted) — base rate: $0.0075 / 1k tokens; estimated monthly cost at current usage: ~$9k
- Dedicated upsell — committed 12-month reserved capacity starting at $18k/mo for the 4x G5x config (expected to cover reranking + caching) with a blended per-token effective rate closer to $0.005–0.006. We can model a graduated discount for higher commits.

Next steps (revised)
- I attached the tailored quote (ACME_Renewal_Quote_2026-09.pdf) and Q2 usage export (usage_report_q2_2026.csv). Please review with procurement.
- Proposed follow-up: Wed 25 Aug 10:00 AM PST or Thu 26 Aug 2:00 PM PST — I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm.
- If procurement wants an SOW/addendum draft, we can spin that and include it with the contract.

Links: HubSpot deal (https://hubspot.example/deal/ACME-2026-RNW-1782), DocuSign (https://docusign.example/sign/ACME_RENEWAL_1782)

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marissa
